raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 was delivered twice (ingest_ts 02:00 and 05:00 on 2026-01-18), so every txn_id in it appears twice with identical content. That gives 654 rows for 2026-01-17 and 327 duplicated txn_ids in silver_transactions. The fix is to dedupe by txn_id in silver; the gold tables rebuild from silver.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
